---
title: "Ad delivery responsiveness to personality alignment"
output: html_notebook
---

Dependencies: `dplyr`, `sandwich`, `lmtest`, `marginaleffects`, `ggplot2`.

```{r}
library(dplyr)

combined_df <- read.csv("../data/reach_results.csv")

combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(Alignment = ifelse(mapply(grepl, Audience, AdType), "aligned", "misaligned"))
```


```{r}
outliers <- with(
  combined_df,
  (Trial == 4 & ProfilingMethod == "Psychometric" &
     Audience == "Extrovert" & AdID == "Introvert-ad-1") |
  (Trial == 4 & ProfilingMethod == "Behavioral" &
     Audience == "Introvert" & AdID == "Extrovert-ad-2")
)

model_df <- combined_df[!outliers, ]
nrow(model_df)
```


```{r}
library(sandwich)
library(lmtest)

model_df$Audience <- as.factor(model_df$Audience)
model_df$Alignment <- as.factor(model_df$Alignment)
model_df$Trial <- as.factor(model_df$Trial)
model_df$AdID <- as.factor(model_df$AdID)
model_df$ProfilingMethod <- as.factor(model_df$ProfilingMethod)

model <- glm(
  cbind(Reach, Fail) ~ Audience * Alignment * ProfilingMethod + AdID,
  data = model_df,
  family = quasibinomial
)

vcov_trial <- vcovCL(model, cluster = model_df$Trial)

coeftest(model, vcov. = vcov_trial)
```

## Simple effects

Change in predicted reach proportion when framing switches from aligned
to misaligned, within each audience and profiling method, on the
probability scale.

```{r}
library(marginaleffects)

alignment_effects <- comparisons(
  model,
  variables = list(Alignment = "reference"),
  by = c("Audience", "ProfilingMethod"),
  vcov = vcov_trial
)

alignment_effects
```

## Predicted reach

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

preds <- predictions(
  model,
  by = c("Alignment", "Audience", "ProfilingMethod"),
  vcov = vcov_trial
)

ggplot(as.data.frame(preds),
       aes(x = Audience, y = estimate, color = Alignment)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.5), size = 4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                position = position_dodge(0.5), width = 0.15, linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ProfilingMethod) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(aligned = "#1071e5", misaligned = "#e76f51")) +
  labs(x = "Audience personality", y = "Predicted reach", color = "Condition") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top",
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))
```

## Diagnostics

```{r}
summary(model)$dispersion
plot(model, which = c(1, 2))
```
